title: 106th Rescue Wing September Team Rescue TV
description: The 106th Rescue Wing produces its monthly news broadcast Team Rescue TV at Francis S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., September 6, 2024. Team Rescue TV is the 106th's monthly news broadcast that informs the Wing on events and training conducted throughout each month. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Captain Cheran Campbell, Technical Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Technical Sgt. Sean Madden, Technical Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, and Senior Airman Sarah McKernan)
keywords: 106th Rescue Wing, NYNG, Air National Guard
credit: Capt. Cheran Campbell, Tech. Sgt. Kevin Donaldson, Tech. Sgt. Daniel Farrell, Tech. Sgt. Sean Madden, Senior Airman Sarah McKernan
